title: Flexible care keeps choice freely given
meaning: Your care can support chosen closeness when changed circumstances meet help considering both people’s different wishes and capacities.
text: Choosing each other need not require identical adjustments to plans every time. In the physical position of Anahata, Temperance expresses care through actions combining different needs without either disappearing. The Wheel of Fortune in energy brings a wish to find available involvement within changing circumstances. The Lovers in emotions offer reciprocity and chosen closeness. Tenderness may come from change not making a personal wish an obstacle to togetherness. Support preserves room for an actual answer.

For example, one person’s personal meeting shifts, leaving no room for a joint workshop visit that evening. You divide what is available: one collects necessary materials along the way, and later you look at them calmly at home. **Another measure of help can preserve choosing to be together.** Neither the personal commitment nor all attention to the shared must be abandoned. Warmth stays in a voluntary concrete step rather than testing who surrendered more time to prove love.

Flexibility can make a new need inconvenient when one person always adapts completely. Alternatively, chosen closeness becomes a demand to accept every substitute. Care loses freedom. Warmth preserves room to name disappointment and revise involvement. An available response can be valued without being declared ideal, while one change need not finally assess your entire readiness to be together.
